messages:
Priya: heads-up — Snyk flagged a glibc vuln in our base images (distroless-slim variant). We need a rapid rebase + coord on keystore rotation and RBAC changes. Target: patch + canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

Kevin: ack. which CVE and which images exactly?

Priya: CVE-2026-GLIBC-4567. Affects rbi-base-ubi:latest and distroless-slim:2025. Minimal rebuild set: base, build-runner, and sidecars.

Maria: I can kick off the bake. Are we rotating cosign key in KMS as part of this?

Sasha: yes — current cosign key needs rotation to meet our 90-day cycle. I own the KMS operator role. Plan: create a new key version, grant image-signer SA access scoped to sign only, then sign artifacts via cosign with KMS. Will open RBAC/ClusterRole patch for a short window.

Aj: for audit/logging: capture KMS Encrypt/AsymmetricSign calls + cosign cli events. I'll add a fluentd filter to tag signer ops and a CloudAudit log sink. Also creating an alert for signing failures.

Priya: proposed sequence:
1) Maria builds patched images to staging registry
2) Sasha creates new KMS key version and adds image-signer SA
3) Maria signs with cosign/KMS
4) Small staging canary (5 pods)
5) Verify vuln scan, provenance, smoke, and audit logs
6) Promote and apply tightened RBAC for production

deploy-bot: pipeline "bake-base-glibc-patch" queued by Maria at 2026-03-21T18:50:12Z

Maria: kicking bake now:
```./scripts/bake.sh --variant=distroless-slim --patch=cve-2026-glibc-4567 --out=staging-registry.redwood.internal``` 

Kevin: question — how do older clusters without the KMS plugin handle signing? fallback to legacy signer?

Sasha: fallback plan: legacy HTTP signer remains available for 8h post-cutover. Rollout config includes circuit-breaker: if signer errors >5% for 2m, revert routing to legacy signer.

Aj: audit PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3399 (adds keystore.access log, tags cosign events). Alert rule ID: alerting/si-1199 created for signer_errors > 0 for 1m.

Priya: Mike — can you review the IAM binding for image-signer SA? Posting ARN + justification.

Mike: will review, paste ARN + minimal justification.

Priya: ARN: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/img-signer/cryptoKeys/img-signer-key
Justification: rotate signing key to remediate glibc rebuilds; access limited to image-signer SA for AsymmetricSign only. Runbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/security/runbooks/302

Sasha: IAM binding applied in dev; staged keystore smoke test passed. RBAC patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/k8s/pulls/902

Maria: staging canary passed vuln-scan and smoke. cosign verify logs show signature with new key version.

Kevin: SRE note — signing cycles spike CPU on builder pods (crypto ops). Watch CPU/IO and backoff if needed.

Aj: fluentd tags present; audit sink shows KMS AsymmetricSign entries. No signer_errors.

Priya: scheduling prod cutover at 02:00 UTC. I'll share calendar invite and rollback checklist. Rollback: re-tag previous image and revert signer routing to legacy signer.

Maria: promoting signed manifests to prod-registry and starting prod canary (5 pods).

deploy-bot: rollout started: canary=5 timeout=10m

Aj: prod audit events are flowing. cosign verify OK against new key version.

Sasha: leaving legacy signer reachable for 6h. Opening follow-up to restrict image-signer RBAC to exact namespaces: https://git.internal/redwood/k8s/issues/853

Mike: IAM binding approved.

Priya: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and update the image rebuild runbook. :thumbsup:
